quote: Crucially, however, even after adding verbal narration, original ﬁndings could still not reliably be replicated
reason: Although positive DLS occurred in the FB1 subcondition (which the authors note on p. 12 is "in itself ambiguous" and did not differ from the prior failed non-verbal replication), FB2 DLS and first saccades did not show belief-congruent looking, and the authors explicitly conclude in the Abstract, Discussion (p. 11), and Highlights that the original looking patterns and implicit Theory of Mind findings could not be replicated.
